summary: Reviewed all 10 formulas (mandelbrot, lambda, burningShip, newton3, phoenix, asinhMandelbrot, perpendicularCeltic, magnet1, jm_18, rcl_pick10) across all 7 units each (en + zh/pt/ko/ru/es/fr = 70 units). Technical fidelity holds: every mathSummary, walkthrough explanation, and exercise matches the pinned FRM-like/1 definitions (e.g., burningShip power==2 component rebuild; newton3 z2/z3/numerator/denominator quotient with |z - zPrev| >= 0.000001; magnet1 ratio-squared with |z| <= 4; rcl_pick10 strict |z| < 8; jm_18 nested fn1/fn2/fn3 with |z| <= t), and every cited nodeId describes the operation at that anchor (init/0 branches, correct loop indices such as magnet1 loop/2 ratio and loop/3 square, perpendicularCeltic loop/1 and loop/5 folds). parameterExperiment.parameterSymbols use runtime slotNames (power, phoenixP, parameter1/function1-3); the classicBinding p1/fn1-3 divergence is valid per contract. No-parameter formulas use the permitted half-vs-pinned iteration design (48 vs 96; 64 vs 128 for rcl_pick10) without claiming the lower count as the pinned value. Expected observations consistently decline guaranteed visual differences. Rights/provenance preserved exactly for all three lanes: project-owned/publish-project-owned-native-recipe for ordinals 1-8, source-declared-public-domain-assumption/direct-adaptation/publish-census-full-chain-green for jm_18, and no-explicit-permission/separated-independent-rewrite/publish-cleanroom-independent-rewrite-full-chain-green for rcl_pick10; sourceIds, sourceRevision and semanticHash strings match the packet. Locale fidelity holds: localized walkthrough key sets equal the English annotation subsets, identifiers/code tokens (ismand, asinh, sqr, real(z), FRM-like/1, parameter names) are preserved, no added facts or stronger certainty, and required registers are systemic (pt você, ko 해요체, ru formal вы, es tú, fr tu) with no English fallback sentences outside protected tokens. Profile quality labels are respected (family-quality newton3/asinhMandelbrot overviews avoid the 'mechanical' label used for the eight mechanical profiles). No visible contract drift beyond the separately-run mechanical shape/hash gates.
